title: Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - December 11, 2025
title_cn: 《守望先锋2》正式服补丁说明 - 2025年12月11日
note:
### Overwatch 2 Retail Patch Notes - December 11, 2025

#### Damage

![Vendetta](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BExf/256X256/d7cc86b5b0180f07499570e6c51efc349a9e4a2de65efedcccaaf047d1941020-t.png)

##### Vendetta

Palatine Fang

* Overhead swing recovery can now be interrupted by Warding Stance
* Fixed a bug with launching enemies downward with the overhead not working consistently against flying targets

Whirlwind Dash

* Raging Storm perk recovery time reduced from 0.4 to 0.25 seconds

Projected Edge

* Recovery time for Whirlwind Dash and Soaring Slice reduced from 0.35 to 0.2 seconds

Soaring Slice

* Recovery time reduced from 0.25 to 0.1 seconds
* Weapon throw range increased from 14 to 15 meters

#### Bug Fixes

* Winter Wonderland Challenges are all working as intended
* Fixed a bug with D.Va's Perk, Extended Boosters which was preventing the damage increase from being applied
note_cn:
### 《守望先锋2》正式服补丁说明 - 2025年12月11日

#### 输出

![斩仇](https://img.51shazhu.com/autoupload/e9kp1/20261017/BExf/256X256/d7cc86b5b0180f07499570e6c51efc349a9e4a2de65efedcccaaf047d1941020-t.png)

##### 斩仇

宫廷利齿

* 过顶挥击的后摇现在可以被守备姿态打断
* 修复了使用过顶挥击将敌人向下击飞时，对飞行目标无法稳定生效的问题

旋风突进

* “狂暴风暴”特长的恢复时间从0.4秒减少至0.25秒

投射锋刃

* 旋风突进和腾空斩的恢复时间从0.35秒减少至0.2秒

腾空斩

* 恢复时间从0.25秒减少至0.1秒
* 武器投掷距离从14米增加至15米

#### 错误修复

* 雪国仙境挑战现在运作正常
* 修复了D.Va的“延长推进器”特长无法正确应用伤害加成的问题
